status.value: current (2700CT1101 v02 dated 2025-12 listed on se.com; OEM interiors catalog 2700CT1601 v1.3 2023-01)
status.note: Status inferred from current document listings; documents themselves not retrieved

main_ampacity.value: Sections to 5000 A horizontal bus, 3000 A vertical bus; single mains to 5000 A; six subdivision mains to 4000 A; individually mounted feeders to 4000 A

branch_breakers.value: Group-mounted I-Line: FA, FH, HD, HG, HJ, HL, QB, QD, QG, QJ, JD, JG, JJ, JL, LA, LH, LC, LI, FI, KI, MG, MJ, PG, PK, PJ, PL (and -C 100% variants), RG-C, RK-C, RJ-C, RL-C; group-mounted QMB/QMJ fusible switches 30-1200 A

families.overview: Free-standing UL 891 low-voltage switchboard, 91.5 in. high with base channels, front or front-and-rear accessible, NEMA 1 or 3R. Distribution is by group-mounted I-Line plug-on breaker sections (interiors up to 3000 A single-row / 2000 A double-row) or QMB/QMJ fusible switch sections, plus individually mounted PowerPact M/P/R, Masterpact NW or Bolt-Loc BP mains/feeders. Adding sections later requires the through-bus construction with splice-plate extensions; through bus sits at top, middle or bottom at 19.5, 27.5 or 36.0 in. from the front.

dimensions.value: Height 91.5 in. (2324 mm) with base channels; section widths 12, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 54 in.; frame depths 24, 36, 48, 54, 60 in.; NEMA 3R adds 11.50 in. front and 0.50 in. rear

i_line_interiors.value: Full-height I-Line distribution: 2000 A interiors (36/42/48 in. W; mounting space 54 or 72 in.) and 3000 A interior (54 in. W, L=72 in., R=40.5 in., min depth 36 in.)

i_line_section_limits.value: Max I-Line interior 3000 A, single row only; double-row interiors 2000 A max; no 4000 A I-Line section
i_line_section_limits.note: Schneider FAQ seen via search summary

qmb_sections.value: Group-mounted QMB switch sections: 36 in. W max switch 400 A; 42 in. W 1200 A; 48 in. W (2) 1200 A; interior 2000 A (36/42 in.) or 3000 A (48 in.); 42 in. main switch connector access space

qmb_mount_height.value: QED-2 Series 2 eliminated the 72 in. QMB switch mounting height option; 63 in. is standard

through_bus.value: Connect-to-existing data needed: factory order number, equipment type (QED-2/S, QED-2 Series 2, QED-3, QED-4, special), through-bus location top/middle/bottom, bus bar size 1.5 or 2.0 in. if <=2000 A, through-bus depth 19.5/27.5/36.0 in.

splice.value: Stand-alone QED switchboards have no through-bus feature; only boards built with through-bus construction and splice-plate extensions can have sections added

bottom.value: All QED-2 switchboards (NEMA 1 or 3R) ship with bottom open; bottom closure plates are an order adder

families.name: Speed-D Merchandised Service Section Switchboard

qmb_fillers.value: Furnished with (2) 15 in. closing plates QMB15BLW; other closing plates QMB1BLW, QMB3BLW, QMB6BLW

families.name: QMB Fusible Panelboard / QMB distribution (current design, Series E1)

era.value: Catalog 4620CT9601 copyright 1985-2015; current design post-October 1984 (older QM/QW interiors pre-1984)

status.value: current

main_ampacity.value: Main lug interiors 225-1200 A; main switch 200-800 A; QMJ only on 400, 600, 800, 1200 A interiors; QMB panelboards limited to 800 A main and branch switches (1200 A QMB368W only in QED-2)

branch_breakers.value: QMB twin and single fusible switch units 30-800 A (1200 A in QED-2 only), QMJ Class J switch units 30-600 A, QMB circuit breaker units (twin H-frame HD/HG 15-150 A; single JD/JG 150-250 A and LA/LH 225-400 A), NEMA size 0-3 motor starter units, QMB Surgelogic TVSS

families.overview: Extruded-bus fusible distribution system used both as stand-alone panelboards and as the QMB distribution section of QED-2 / Speed-D switchboards. Branch units have permanently attached mounting brackets and blow-on plug-on jaws onto the QMB bus and mount with a screwdriver; glass-reinforced polyester bus supports. ISCR up to 200 kA at 600 Vac with Class R/J/L/T fuses.

standards.value: UL 67, UL 50, CSA C22.2 No. 29, NEMA PB 1, Fed Spec W-P115C; switch units UL 98 File E34358

families.name: I-Line Circuit Breaker Panelboard / I-Line distribution section

status.value: current

voltage_rating.value: Up to 600 Vac; AC or DC systems

branch_breakers.value: I-Line plug-on breakers 15-1200 A frames: FA, FH, BD/BG/BJ/BK, HD/HG/HJ/HL/HR, QB/QD/QG/QJ, JD/JG/JJ/JL/JR, LA/LH, LD/LG/LJ/LL/LR, MG/MJ, PG/PJ/PK/PL, RG/RJ/RK/RL

families.overview: Plug-on I-Line bus stack: breaker line-end jaws are integral to the breaker, shrouded in a molded insulator that keys into slots in the bus support base, are factory lubricated/preset and are 'blow-on'. The load end is held by an integral mounting bracket/foot screwed to the interior pan. The same interiors, fillers and extensions are used in QED switchboard I-Line distribution sections.

qed_compat.value: I-Line panelboard fillers and extensions are the same for current I-Line distribution sections in QED switchboards

mounting.value: 15-1200 A breakers require only a screwdriver; firmly attached to bus stack and mechanically attached to interior; load-end mounting bracket is integral to each breaker

families.overview: Older QMB fusible distribution used in panelboards and switchboards before the current (Series E1) design. Legacy switch catalog numbers had no 'W' suffix (e.g. QMB3606T, QMB310T, QMB3620, QMB3240, QMB2240, QMB3260).
